{1c:20}{0b:08}【 Luca 】{0b:09}
H-hurry... Please... kill me...
strings.tl: H-hurry... Please... kill me...

strings.en:
{1c:20}{0b:08}【 Luca 】{0b:09}
God's judgment... upon me...
strings.tl: God's judgment... upon me...
Thank... you... [VAR14]-san...

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 {10} 】{0b:09}
Luca... Rest in peace...
strings.tl: Luca... Rest in peace...
Goodbye... Luca...
L-Luca...

せめて神の名の下に死ね・・・

{0b:08}【 Leia 】{0b:09}
At the least, die in the name of God...
strings.tl: At the least, die in the name of God...

strings.en:

L-Luca...

Luca...

strings.en:

L-Luca...

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
Farewell, Luca-san.
strings.tl: Farewell, Luca-san.

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Jessica 】{0b:09}
Luca...
strings.tl: Luca...

{0b:08}{e090} オルフェウス {e091}{0b:09}
さようなら、ルカさん。

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
Farewell, Luca-san.

Goodbye. I won't forget you... probably, anyway.
